notes.title: Update 0.6: Stuff for Cats
notes.notes:
[h3]🔺[b]Important:[/b] [/h3][p]Due to the large content update, the game's price has increased to [b]$2[/b]. Thank you for your support![/p][p][/p][h3]✨ [b]New Content:[/b][/h3][p][b]1. Cat Items:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Litter Box[/b] — the cat will now use it for bathroom needs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scratching Post[/b] — the cat will only leave scratches near it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toy[/b] and [b]Ball[/b] — the cat can play with them to increase activity and fun.

[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349120/1e878c4cf61f8ea6d4b1d62669605a0f83cdb96f.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349120/1e878c4cf61f8ea6d4b1d62669605a0f83cdb96f.gif"][/img][/url][/p][/*][/list][p][b]2. Cat Bowl and New Food Types:[/b]
You can now place food into the bowl. Three food types:[/p][list][*][p][b]Regular Food[/b] — restores 100% hunger.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Milk[/b] — restores 50% hunger and triggers [b]zoomies[/b] behavior.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fish[/b] — restores hunger and [b]increases love[/b].

[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349120/7cad8d21f825e36b432ce5df7821f37c4da4b11a.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349120/7cad8d21f825e36b432ce5df7821f37c4da4b11a.gif"][/img][/url][/p][/*][/list][p][b]3. Jumping Animation:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349120/e422de9465d4316013dc77c433c9f3414ce116c5.gif"][/img]
New jump animation added for the cat.[/p][quote][p]⚠️ Custom cat skins need to be [b]updated and reuploaded to the Workshop[/b] to support it.[/p][/quote][p][b]4. "Walk on Border" Mode:[/b]
The cat can now walk [b]up, down, and even on the ceiling[/b] of the screen.[/p][p][b]5. Zoomies Behavior:[/b]
Added a new behavior pattern for [b]zoomies[/b] — the cat will energetically run around the screen.[/p][p][b]6. UI & Game Scaling:[/b]
You can now [b]adjust the size of the UI and in-game elements[/b] in the settings.

[/p][h3]🐛 [b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reduced the volume of [b]scratching[/b] sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]The cat now sleeps [b]shorter[/b] when falling asleep on its own.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]missing animation segments[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the [b]"Eating"[/b] sound type from the sound settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated several [b]Chinese translations[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: 0.3.7 Update
notes.notes:
List of changes:

- Achievement the Star 150 is working.
- The Cat can to create a poop.
- Cleaning up poop brings a star.
- The Cat meows when hungry.
- Duration of the adventure - 15 minutes (Previously it was 30 min).
- The Cat can to hunting on your Mouse time to time.
- FIX: The setting of volume can be set to zero.

notes.title: 0.3.6 Small changes
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug: Star does not disappear completely.
- Fixed bug: Feeding brings Star.
- Fixed bug: Cat move after sleeping in bed.
- You can to change frame rate in the settings menu.
- You can to change cat volume in the settings menu.
- You can to change UI volume in the settings menu.
- Tray: Hide/Show game.
- Do not allow moving cat/bed by dragging outside the screen.
